description: Weekly dependency update pull requests. docs/testing.md#dependency-updates explains these settings.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the 14-day wait, as AGENTS.md allows.

packageRules.description: Gradle updates, the version catalog and the wrapper included, use the build type.
GitHub Actions and runner updates use the ci type.
Kotlin's plugins and kotlin-test share one catalog version, and the Compose compiler ships with Kotlin. KSP runs on Kotlin's compiler, so it is tested with them.
prBodyNotes: A new Kotlin minor version may also need a newer Hilt. See docs/architecture.md#build-settings.

packageRules.description: Each compose-rules release is built for one detekt version, so both change in one pull request, and only after the maintainer approves it on the Dependency Dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Check compose-rules' supported versions table for this detekt version, and read detekt's release notes. See docs/architecture.md#formatting-and-lint.

packageRules.description: The build needs JDK 17, as AGENTS.md says, so the JDK version in the workflow's setup-java step changes only by hand.
AGP sets the default build tools version, which the pull request workflow installs.
prBodyNotes: If the build fails on a missing build-tools package, update the SDK step in .github/workflows/pull-request.yml and the Commands section of AGENTS.md on this branch.

packageRules.description: A ktfmt update can change the formatting.
prBodyNotes: If spotlessCheck fails, run ./gradlew spotlessApply on this branch and push the result.

packageRules.description: Renovate writes the new checksum before it runs the wrapper task, so the checksum changes even when the task fails.
prBodyNotes: If gradle-wrapper.jar, gradlew and gradlew.bat didn't change, run ./gradlew wrapper on this branch and push any changes it makes.

customManagers.description: ktfmt has no library entry in the catalog, because Spotless downloads it.
Gummy Bears has no library entry, because build-logic builds the artifact name from minSdk. Change api-29 here when minSdk changes.
